nodes.label: Ad-hoc signed Release package
nodes.rationale: Developer ID signing and notarization were deferred at MVP so a distributable zip could exist without an Apple Developer account; ad-hoc signing yields a valid codesign receipt while spctl rejection and a right-click-to-Open first launch are accepted, documented deltas.

nodes.label: Embedded Mirage runtime
nodes.rationale: The pinned CPython 3.12.7 engine is copied into Contents/Resources/mirage-runtime and signed so the packaged app ships a self-contained analysis engine; smoke runs use a copy and set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1/-B so __pycache__ cannot invalidate the code signature.

nodes.label: GRDB SQLite foundation
nodes.rationale: GRDB.swift 7.11.1 was chosen over hand-rolled SQLite as the second pinned SPM dependency to get WAL, foreign keys, and a busy-safe pool; the schema was proven by migration without cutting the live store over so the parity risk stayed contained.

nodes.label: Lazy page-timing loading
nodes.rationale: The 138,459-row page-timing monolith is the source of the ~100x load improvement: SQLite mode loads session summaries and cached seconds-per-page instead of 138k rows, dropping library load from 493.7 ms to 5.06 ms while preserving exact speed analytics.

nodes.label: DataStore.StorageEngine (json / sqlite)
nodes.rationale: The engine switch keeps DataStore's public API unchanged and falls back to legacy JSON if migration fails, so the SQLite cutover carried no call-site churn and retained a production escape hatch.

nodes.label: Real-data SQLite cutover
nodes.rationale: The production app was switched to .sqlite only after the real library (7 books, 292 sessions, 138,459 timings) migrated with matching counts and relaunched from SQLite alone; legacy JSON was renamed .migrated rather than deleted so rollback stays a rename away.

nodes.label: WeatherProviding protocol
nodes.rationale: Weather access was abstracted behind a protocol so Open-Meteo can serve live/archive/forecast paths without a WeatherKit entitlement, while WeatherKit remains an optional implementation.

nodes.label: Location honesty (no default NYC)
nodes.rationale: Returning New York City when location was .notDetermined or .denied fabricated data; the gate replaces silent defaults with honest errors, a visible paused banner, and a manual latitude/longitude fallback so weather evidence is never invented.

nodes.label: Behavior Context V3
nodes.rationale: V3 is deterministic rules only — no LLM or network — so context reports stay reproducible and privacy-preserving; the session-close cascade and launch history analysis both feed FullIntegrationInput through the existing adapters.

nodes.label: behavior-evidence.json archive
nodes.rationale: Behavioral evidence persists through relaunch in a JSON archive with a retention policy rather than the SQLite behavior tables, so the observation API remains unchanged and a later SQLite migration can replace the archive without touching the engine.

nodes.label: Swift 6 strict-concurrency deferral
nodes.rationale: Flipping SWIFT_VERSION=6.0 plus complete strict concurrency produced 148 actor-isolation errors, concentrated in DataMaturityEngine and MainActor-default surfaces; the settings were reverted to the proven Swift 5 mode because a silent half-migration was judged worse than an explicit, documented follow-up.

nodes.label: Severity and confidence marks
nodes.rationale: Four severity levels (critical/high/medium/low) plus a high/medium confidence rating let readers triage by real-world impact and evidence strength, distinguishing traced-in-code findings from suspected ones.

nodes.label: ID-space disambiguation (NEW-DE ledgers)
nodes.rationale: Two separate campaigns both used NEW-DE prefixed IDs (the October audit punch list and the merge campaign's discrepancy ledger), so the register warns readers to check the owning document before searching an ID to avoid cross-ledger confusion.

nodes.label: Fix protocol (Finality, log entry, pinned test)
nodes.rationale: Every fix must state why it is the right fix (Finality), get exactly one log entry, and gain an automated test proving the bug cannot return; one defect, one Finality, one log entry keeps traceability intact and prevents unproven repairs from being recorded as done.

nodes.label: persistenceHealth banner
nodes.rationale: Silent save/load failures in Release were the original data-loss class; a published health status degrading at every silent catch and rendering as a persistent bottom banner makes every failure visible instead of lost to the console.

nodes.label: THE SENTINEL watchdog
nodes.rationale: Sentinel is a deterministic rule-driven watchdog: 8 pure-read probes feed a classifier (autoFixed vs stalled), an audited-API dispatcher, and an append-only JSONL journal, running on launch and on an interval; it auto-fixes only provably safe findings and stalls the rest for human review.

nodes.label: Sentinel security doctrine S1–S7
nodes.rationale: S1 write confinement to sentinel-* files, S2 backup-before-mutation with skip-if-unbackuppable, S3 append-only journal, S4 static Release strings, S5 a defaults-write kill switch, S6 conservative Debug-repairs/Release-monitors defaults, and S7 no network or randomness make an autonomous repair engine auditable and safely disableable.

nodes.label: P5-G Storage Engine 2.0 revert
nodes.rationale: The first SQLite attempt died SIGTERM mid-suite from a connection-lifecycle race under SQLITE_ENABLE_THREAD_ASSERTIONS; per the Confidence Rules Finality was not reached, so the engine was reverted with zero user impact and the work reopened in a dedicated session that became GRDB G3A.

nodes.label: SWIFT_DEFAULT_ACTOR_ISOLATION MainActor hotfix
nodes.rationale: Because SWIFT_DEFAULT_ACTOR_ISOLATION=MainActor made even Task.detached closures main-actor-isolated, the demo-install background pipeline performed roughly one million hops back to main; marking model inits and synthesis helpers nonisolated makes the fix compiler-enforced, so any regression breaks the build loudly.

nodes.label: Standing constraints
nodes.rationale: Constraints such as whole-file rewrites only for BehaviorContextEngine2/BehavioralCategory, explicit nonisolated on background paths under MainActor default isolation, no -derivedDataPath on iCloud checkouts (BUG-003), never unifying Mirage and RT stores, and sample-before-reasoning during freezes encode hard-won failure modes so the next person does not repeat them.

nodes.label: Asterisma rebrand and data-root migration
nodes.rationale: The product, targets, module, and copy were renamed to AsterismaV1.0 and the data root moved from ReadTracker to Asterisma, but the sandbox bundle ID johan.Reading-Tracker was intentionally kept so the existing container and years of reading history were not orphaned.

nodes.label: Scalability thresholds (~10x / ~100x volume)
nodes.rationale: At ~10x today's volume uncached whole-library analytics starts dropping frames and JSON save bursts stall; at ~100x the store rewrite and analytics scans dominate and the weather store grows unpruned — this evidence justifies the lazy/aggregate SQLite rewrite rather than speculative optimization.

nodes.label: Preserve-list
nodes.rationale: The persistence hardening cluster, documentation-truth norm, defect-class-pinned suites, DataMaturityEngine architecture, and minimal entitlement grant are explicitly protected from opportunistic 'improvement' while other fixes land, because they encode prior incident lessons.

nodes.label: Repo-wide definition of done
nodes.rationale: Done means every NA/F item is fixed-verified-logged or explicitly dispositioned, the suite is green at every phase boundary from verified runs, the fix log is complete, and no file asserts a wiring/fixed state the code contradicts.

nodes.label: NA-1 Weather-fix contradiction
nodes.rationale: The live weather engine still hardcoded confidence, used unsorted first/last observed dates, and labeled the rarest genres 'avoided' while a dead 'Fix 1/2/3' block claimed otherwise; the roadmap requires either wiring truthfully or deleting the claim, because no file may assert a bug is fixed when it is not.

nodes.label: NA-2 Goals end-to-end
nodes.rationale: Goal APIs updateGoalSet/addDeadline had zero callers and the dashboard pointed at nonexistent settings, making goal achievements structurally unearnable; the roadmap sequences a Settings shell, then an editor bound to the already-tested persistence APIs, then F-08 streak detection.
